narration.full_text: Namaste students! Today, we're going to embark on an exciting journey to understand how living organisms control and coordinate their various activities. We'll explore the fascinating world of the nervous system, reflex actions, and even how plants manage their movements and responses. By the end of this lesson, you will be able to understand the fundamental concepts of control and coordination in living organisms. You will also explore the structure and function of the nervous system and neurons. We'll learn about reflex actions and the reflex arc, and discover the parts and functions of the human brain. Additionally, we will examine coordination and movement mechanisms in plants, and identify key plant and animal hormones and their roles.
